The uniform empirical CDF concentration/Borel–Cantelli and endpoint truncated-sum bounds control pathwise convergence to integral C(s); bounded-expectation tail estimate gives L1, not merely convergence in probability. Strict power monotonicity follows each observed ratio in (0,1). No simulation is substituted for n->infinity.
